title: Silab unveils Metallomia, a detoxifying active ingredient for menopausal skin
summary: Derived from the roots of marshmallow, Silab's new natural active ingredient targets the body's iron regulation process to ensure the controlled release of iron in menopausal skin. Thus, Metallomia combats “metal-linked-aging” and improves skin resilience to UV. Metallomia, the latest detoxifying active ingredient from French manufacturer Silab, was specifically developed to target the deficiency of ferritinophagy in menopausal skin. “Metallo-aging” Actually, thanks to a novel modeling... - Ingredients & formulation
